does_not_prove: that a current authorize call would ALLOW the same change today — issuance was live at captured_at, not re-verified against the live server

that this grant can be REPLAYED — it is a cr.exec.v2 ATOMIC grant binding sha256 of a state nonce the executor minted, and the preimage is recorded nowhere (the issuer only ever saw the hash). Measured: replaying it is refused STATE_NONCE_REQUIRED, and a guessed nonce STATE_NONCE_UNBOUND. Authorization continuity is therefore a LIVE-only measurement; this fixture records that an authorize happened, never that this run consumed it
that this grant authorizes a mutation on the local demo executor — it is a CodeRifts server grant (kid 2026-07-k1), not a DEMO-KEY data-plane grant
